title: Flipster Earn Campaign begins
description: Flipster's reviewed first-party campaign FAQ states that the Flipster Earn Campaign began on 3 April 2024 at 00:00 UTC.
notes: This is the verified start of the reviewed Earn Campaign lineage; it is not asserted to prove that no earlier Flipster yield feature existed.

title: Updated Flipster Premium Earn terms take effect
description: Flipster required Premium Earn users to accept updated terms effective 5 March 2026, with balances automatically returned to USDT for users who did not accept the update.
notes: This records a current Premium Earn terms transition, not an umbrella Flipster Earn relaunch.

title: Bitrue confirms Power Piggy remains central entering 2026
description: Bitrue's 2026 outlook described Power Piggy as its long-running flexible-staking product and stated that more than 120 assets were available for staking on the platform.
notes: The source confirms continuing operation but does not provide an exact original 2019 launch day.

title: Bitrue launches 2026 XRP Power Piggy flexible pool
description: Bitrue published a new XRP Power Piggy flexible-staking pool with no lockup, confirming active Power Piggy operation in 2026.
notes: This is a current product availability event, not the original Power Piggy launch date.
